role_summary: FinOps Engineer role for AWS, OCI and hybrid environments, emphasizing insurance-sector cost optimization, automation, reporting and governance.
responsibility_text: Optimize AWS, OCI and hybrid cloud spend; rightsizing and reserved-instance strategies; cost dashboards; anomaly remediation; tagging, allocation, chargeback and showback; budgeting and forecasting; automate cost reporting and alerts with Python and Terraform; integrate FinOps controls into CI/CD; track unit economics; collaborate with Cloud Engineering, Finance, Security, Product Owners and Business teams.
requirement_text: AWS and OCI pricing and billing; CloudHealth, Apptio, Flexera or Cloudability; Python; Terraform; Power BI, QuickSight, Grafana or OCI Analytics; governance, auditability and cost transparency; financial modelling and stakeholder management.
preferred_text: FinOps Certified Practitioner or Professional; AWS Cloud Financial Management certification; Azure cost certification; Google Cloud Digital Leader; CCSP; Power BI Data Analyst Associate.
